items.text: New topic: Richter transformation, first-line and relapsed disease together: 43 studies on risk, biology and diagnosis, chemoimmunotherapy and transplantation, BTK, BCL2 and checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific antibodies and CAR T cells, and the Hodgkin variant, with trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: relapsed/refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia, 26 studies from chemoimmunotherapy to BTK inhibitors and their head-to-head trials, venetoclax-based therapy, PI3K inhibitors and treatment after both drug classes, with a Perspective, trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New disease: chronic lymphocytic leukemia. The first topic, untreated CLL, covers 30 studies from chemoimmunotherapy to continuous BTK inhibitors and fixed-duration venetoclax combinations, with a Perspective, trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: primary bone lymphoma, an evidence map of 39 studies in adults (treatment series, registries, prognosis, single versus multiple lesions, biology, circulating tumor DNA, non-DLBCL histologies, imaging), with a grid showing what has and has not been published, and a Perspective on how to read this evidence.

Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: a Perspective on how treatment evolved is now open on both topics, and three phase 2 trials of targeted drugs with R-CHOP were added to untreated disease (ECOG-ACRIN E1412, Smart Start, GUIDANCE-01).
New disease: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, in two topics: untreated (38 studies) and relapsed/refractory (28 studies).
